activation: the project is trusted, the design-space hook is approved in /hooks, and Codex is started in the {{FOLDER}} folder
limits: A hook that cannot start (for example when node or git is missing, or there is no POSIX shell) may let the call through; Codex does not document what a failing or timed-out hook does.
Until the project is trusted and the hook approved in /hooks, Codex skips the hook without blocking anything, and any change to the hook needs a new approval.
The hook never sees hosted tools such as WebSearch, nor write_stdin sending input to a command that is already running.
